sections.heading: Pricing caveats
sections.body: Verified 2026-08-17 from getresponse.com/pricing and /pricing/free. Paid Starter/Marketer/Creator priced by list size (published packages: 1k, 2.5k, 5k, 10k, 25k, 50k, 100k). Monthly floors at ~1,000 contacts: Starter $19/mo, Marketer $59/mo, Creator $69/mo; annual ~18% off ($15.58 / $48.38 / $56.58). Unlimited monthly sends on paid plans. Free forever: up to 500 contacts, 2,500 newsletters/mo, 1 landing page (post-trial limits). 14-day premium feature trial on Free signup (no credit card). Enterprise: custom quote / book a demo; 30-day Enterprise Pilot via demo. Taxes may apply.
